newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil softer as weak market seeks direction.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil softer as weak market seeks direction.

text.p: IPE gas oil closed lower on Monday in a generally weaker, directionless market, pulled lower by losses in crude, traders said.
Front month August IPE oil futures closed one dollar lower at $162.50 a tonne. September was $1.25 lower at 164.25.
The Brent crude September contract was two cents lower at $18.10 per barrel, while the front month NYMEX crude contract was eight cents lower at $19.19 a barrel.
"It has been a neutral, undecided day of low volume trade," said Frenella Graham, analyst at Mees Pierson. "We've been trading at swing levels rather than through them," she added.
The market traded around a swing level of $162.5 between the upper and lower area of the range, but trade skirted around that level rather than going convincingly above or below it, Graham said.
"We have to decide if $162.5 will develop into support and we're going to return to the upper half of the range and challenge the $166.25 level again, or turn into resistance," she added.
